description: Starting "Q3 roadmap" in two tabs creates two projects with the same name and no warning in either tab. Projects cannot be renamed or deleted, so the duplicate is permanent.
expected: Starting a project whose name matches an existing project (or one created seconds ago) asks "You already have Q3 roadmap. Open it instead?"
actual: Switcher lists "Q3 roadmap" twice, identical labels.
suggested_fix: Warn on duplicate names at Start; distinguish duplicates in the switcher (created date or short ID).

description: When the same invitation is joined from two tabs, tab A joins and tab B says "This invitation was already used by someone else. Ask for a new one." It was used by Jordan himself, in tab A, and he is already a member; asking for a new invitation is wrong advice.
expected: "You already joined Data pipeline audit" with an Open button, or a neutral "This invitation has already been used".
actual: Accusatory "someone else" wording and advice to request a new invitation.
suggested_fix: When INVITE_USED arrives and the project is now in session.projects, switch to it instead of showing the error.

description: A tab that was already open does not list a project created in another tab, even after more than one 15 s poll (17 s wait): "Q4 plan" is missing from tab B's switcher.
expected: The switcher refreshes the project list when it opens, or on the project poll.
actual: Tab B lists 4 projects; the session has 5.
